title: 37+ years of Experience
description: Noted for his prowess in crime detection during his tenure in the detective department.
extra:
Mr. Sujit Chakraborty, a distinguished individual, holds a B.Sc (Hons), LLB, and LLM degree.
With an illustrious career spanning 37 years in the Kolkata Police, he has held various esteemed positions.
Notably, he served as Officer in Charge of 8 police stations and attained the rank of Assistant Commissioner of Police.
His tenure in the Detective department showcased exceptional proficiency in crime detection and investigation of many critical cases in Kolkata.
He earned numerous accolades from the Commissioner of Police Kolkata, Judiciary, and the President of India, including the prestigious Indian Police Medal for meritorious service.
Additionally, Mr. Chakraborty's commitment to global peace was demonstrated through his service in the United Nations Peacekeeping Mission in Kosovo.

title: 37+ years of Experience
description: Investigated various criminal cases. Possesses sound knowledge about court proceedings.
extra: Mr. Md Asim Ali, a distinguished individual, holds B.Sc and LLB degrees. With an illustrious career spanning 37 years in the Kolkata Police Force, he investigated various criminal cases and held charges at different Police Stations as Officer in Charge. Mr. Ali possesses a sound understanding of court proceedings. Additionally, he served for one year as a Police Officer in Kosovo on behalf of the United Nations Peacekeeping Force, demonstrating his commitment to global peace and security.

title: 37+ years of Experience
description: Served as an officer in Kolkata Police for more than 37 years and retired as a DCP.
extra: A distinguished member of our team, Faiyaz Ahmed brings a wealth of experience from his remarkable 37-year career with the Kolkata Police. Retiring as a Deputy Commissioner of Police (DCP), Faiyaz has an unparalleled understanding of crime detection and court proceedings, honed through years of dedicated service. His extensive background, coupled with his B.Sc and LLB degrees, makes him an invaluable asset, offering profound insights into legal and investigative matters. We're incredibly fortunate to have his expertise guiding us.

title: 37+ years of Experience
description: Served over 37 years with Kolkata Police and retired as Assistant Commissioner of Police.
extra: Mr. Amiya Kumar Lahiri is a distinguished legal consultant and former Assistant Commissioner of Police with over 37 years of exemplary service in the Kolkata Police. Holding academic qualifications in both Law and Science from the University of Calcutta, he brings extensive expertise in criminal investigations, forensic analysis, legal advisory, and economic offence cases. Throughout his career, he led complex investigations, managed intelligence and crisis response operations, and played a key role in strengthening coordination between investigative and judicial processes. His unique combination of law enforcement experience and legal acumen makes him a trusted advisor in regulatory compliance, risk management, and complex dispute resolution.

title: 39+ years of Experience
description: Served over 39 years with the Government of India in forensic science.
extra: Mr. Bhakti Pad Mishra is a highly respected forensic science expert with a Master's degree in Chemistry and over 39 years of distinguished service with the Government of India. He retired as Deputy Director & Scientist 'D' (Documents) from the Central Forensic Science Laboratory (CFSL), Kolkata. Renowned for his expertise in forensic document examination, handwriting and signature analysis, forgery detection, and document authentication, he has handled thousands of cases for agencies including the CBI, NIA, banks, and law enforcement authorities. As an experienced expert witness, he has provided crucial forensic opinions in numerous judicial proceedings, making him a trusted authority in forensic investigations and legal matters.

title: 30+ years of Experience
description: Seasoned entrepreneur with over 30 years of experience in hospitality, real estate, and multi-sector business development.
extra: Mr. Ashish Mittal is a seasoned entrepreneur and business leader with over 30 years of experience across hospitality, real estate, project management, event management, and business networking. As the Founder & Managing Director of the MAP5 Group, he has successfully built and expanded multiple ventures, establishing a strong presence in hotel management, infrastructure development, and corporate events. Known for his strategic vision and leadership, he has played a key role in driving business growth while actively contributing to industry and social initiatives focused on community development and positive social impact.

title: 40+ Years of Experience
description: Former Assistant Commissioner of Police with extensive expertise in criminal investigations, anti-terror operations, organized crime, and intelligence-led policing.
extra: Mr. Susanta Dhar is a highly decorated former Assistant Commissioner of Police with over four decades of distinguished service in the Kolkata Police. Having served in the Detective Department and Special Task Force, he possesses extensive expertise in homicide investigations, anti-terror operations, organized crime, counterfeit currency cases, and court proceedings. Throughout his career, he played a key role in investigating several high-profile criminal cases and received multiple commendations for his integrity, professionalism, and dedication to law enforcement. His vast investigative experience and strategic insights make him a valuable advisor in complex security, intelligence, and investigative matters.

title: 35+ Years of Experience
description: Former Assistant Commissioner of Police with extensive expertise in crime administration, investigations, and law enforcement leadership.
extra: Mr. Samrat Dutta is a retired Assistant Commissioner of Police with over 35 years of distinguished service in the Kolkata Police. Beginning his career as a Sub-Inspector, he rose through the ranks on merit and held several key administrative and investigative responsibilities throughout his tenure. He served in leadership roles within major administrative divisions of the Kolkata Police and developed extensive expertise in crime management and police administration. In recognition of his exemplary service, he was awarded the President's Police Medal for Meritorious Service and the Kolkata Police Prashansha Padak. His integrity, professionalism, and dedication to public service continue to make him a valued advisor in investigative and security matters.
